headline: Senate battles over college athlete NIL rights as Colmenero nomination vote looms!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate continued debate on the Protect College Sports Act (S. 4668) with multiple amendments pending, securing cloture on the Cruz substitute amendment by 70-21. The chamber also voted 52-43 to close debate on the Colmenero judicial nomination, which will head to a confirmation vote Wednesday afternoon.
